Class Volume

java.lang.Object
net.murat.material.Volume
public class Volume extends Object
Represents a participating medium (volume) with absorption and scattering. Supports both legacy single-color absorption and chromatic (per-channel) absorption where each RGB channel attenuates at its own rate.

    • Volume

      public Volume(int chromaticColor, double chromaticDensity, int scattering, double scatteringDensity, boolean isEnteringHasPriority)
      Chromatic absorption: each RGB channel attenuates at its own rate. Density for each channel = chromaticDensity * (channelValue / 255.0).
      Parameters:
      chromaticColor - 0x00RRGGBB - per-channel density scaling
      chromaticDensity - base density (>= 0)
      scattering - scattering color
      scatteringDensity - scattering density
      isEnteringHasPriority - priority flag
